description.value: Participants viewed a photograph of a familiar acquaintance alongside a neutral image of a hand holding a pen while recalling acquaintance memories; this neutral-pen condition was followed by a craving rating and covert count-back task.

A 2×2 block-design fMRI task crossed romantic-partner versus familiar-acquaintance photographs with cigarette-cue versus neutral-pen images. Each of four stimulus pairings was repeated three times. Each block began with 2 seconds of fixation, followed by 30 seconds of paired images, a 9-second cigarette-craving rating, and a 26-second covert count-back task from a random four-digit number in sevens.

instructions.value: Participants were instructed to recall memories of their romantic partner or acquaintance and think of those memories when viewing the corresponding photograph. They rated how much they craved a cigarette after each stimulus and mentally counted backward from a displayed random four-digit number in increments of seven during the subsequent task.

stimuli.value: Photographs of the participant's romantic partner or a familiar same-sex acquaintance, paired with either a hand holding a pen, a hand holding a cigarette, or hands lighting a cigarette. The two cigarette cues were averaged during analysis.

spans.text: Object stimuli were always three images: (a) a hand holding a pen (neutral cue), (b) a hand holding a cigarette (cigarette cue) and (c) a person’s hands as they lighted a cigarette (cigarette cue).
